# React Bits Particles

Source: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/tree/main/src/ts-default/Backgrounds/Particles
Documentation: https://reactbits.dev/backgrounds/particles
Retrieved 2026-11-21. Particles.tsx and Particles.css are vendored without modifications.
License: MIT + Commons Clause; full upstream notice in LICENSE.md.

PaperBackground.tsx configures faint pastel dots, disables pointer effects, pauses for reduced motion, and keeps the canvas behind content. No added package dependencies. If WebGL2 is unavailable, the decorative canvas is empty and the paper background remains.
